notes: No SVG of the heart-in-hand exists (first pass). DECISION: ChMeetings shows the mark in two orientations: upright, hand rising on the right (the current file, the site icon Logo-400x400.png; also the in-app app-logo.png and favico.png) and tilted with the hand level (this Android app icon, the web app's touch icon, the PWA icon and the header lockup). Chose the app icon per rule 1; it is transparent and a little larger (512 vs 400px). The current upright file is equally official if the reviewer prefers it. The search's best_raster (s2-2, PWA icon) is the same tilted mark on an added white square. The iOS listing (id1428989403, Jiosdev LLC) currently shows a flame icon, not the heart in hand, so it was not used.
license: ChMeetings brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with ChMeetings.
